requirements: R1: Populate rootCausePatternId on underlying defect events for design review concerns

slices.title: Patch defect event generation to include rootCausePatternId
slices.jtbd: When implementing the event categorization for this epic, I want to populate the rootCausePatternId on defect events, so that task status mismatches can be traced to their underlying invariant patterns.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a defect event is triggered for a design review concern stream
When the system processes the event
Then it populates the rootCausePatternId field with the candidate pattern identifier
Given the defect event is generated
When the system executes the test suite
Then tests confirm the rootCausePatternId is properly assigned
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the rate of uncategorized defect events in the review stream from 100% to 0%
